title: On positive definite thresholding of correlation matrices
summary: Standard thresholding techniques for correlation matrices often destroy positive semidefiniteness. We investigate the construction of positive definite functions that vanish on specific sets $K \subseteq [-1,1)$, ensuring that the thresholded matrix remains a valid correlation matrix. We establish existence results, define a criterion for faithfulness based on the linear coefficient of the normalized Gegenbauer expansion in analogy with Delsarte's method in coding theory, and provide bounds for thresholding at single points and pairs of points.
